description: This file is a C++ header defining a typesafe string formatting library 'str_format' within the Abseil library. It includes class templates, functions, and enums for formatting strings, handling format specifications, and customizing user-defined types. It provides type-safe replacements for printf-style functions and supports compile-time format string validation.

classes.name: UntypedFormatSpec
classes.description: A type-erased class used for untyped formatting API, encapsulating a format string.

classes.name: FormatCountCapture
classes.description: A class to safely capture the number of characters written during formatting, used with '%n'.

classes.name: FormatConversionSpec
classes.description: Represents modifications and flags for a specific format conversion, including width, precision, and flags.

classes.name: FormatSink
classes.description: An abstraction for output sinks to which formatted data can be written.

classes.name: FormatConvertResult
classes.description: Indicates success or failure of a custom format conversion, supporting specific conversion characters.

methods.name: FormatStreamed
methods.description: Wraps a value to enable streaming with '%s' in formatted output.

methods.name: StrFormat
methods.description: Primary function to produce a formatted string from a format spec and arguments.

methods.name: StrAppendFormat
methods.description: Appends formatted output to an existing string.

methods.name: StreamFormat
methods.description: Produces a streamable object for formatted output.

methods.name: FPrintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a FILE* stream.

methods.name: SNPrintF
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a fixed-size buffer.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats data into an arbitrary sink implementing FormatRawSink.

methods.name: FormatUntyped
methods.description: Formats data into an arbitrary sink with runtime format string and arguments.
